gaps.sentence: ___ of my parents speaks French, so I translate for them.
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of' = not one and not the other (two people).

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we sat down ___ the lights went out.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly … when' is the fixed pair; 'than' belongs to 'no sooner'.

gaps.sentence: The first edition of the book ___ out in 1998.
They had no ___ but to call the police.
By this time tomorrow, we ___ have finished the whole report.
gaps.explanation: 'By + future time' calls for the future perfect: will have finished.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is ___ repair, so traffic uses the bypass.
You needn't ___ worried — everything is fine.
